player_prompt.intro: Wena unguMdlali {player_id} kuJoJoJoin, udlalwa ebhodini elingu-5x5 elinamaseli anenombolo engu-0-24. Ngesikhathi sakho, beka uphawu lwakho kunoma iyiphi iseli elingenalutho, isibonelo '[12]'. UYANqoba ngokuthola AMAKHATHU wamamaki akho ngokulandelana  amakamelo amane alandelanayo ngokwendawo, ngokuma, noma ngokuphambene. Njengomdlali {player_id} wena ungu '{symbol}'; umphikisi wakho ungu '{opponent_symbol}'.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Ukuthutha okulethwe lapha akulandeli ifomethi efanele.
invalid_move.out_of_range: {cell} akuyona inqwaba evumelekile. Kumele ibe phakathi kuka-0 no-24.
